listing.name: TheDarkSix - Ship & Weapons Pack (EN Translation)
listing.summary: My poor second translation attempt of a great CN super ship mod.
listing.aiSummary: Adds translated super dreadnoughts, fighters, weapons, and hullmods for core factions.

description: Provides an English translation of a Chinese ship mod. It includes super dreadnoughts for all core factions plus XIV and LG, along with new fighters, weapons, and hullmods. The pack also adds standard ships for all factions, a unique Atlas variant for pirates, and reskins existing ship systems.
